label: Late original-phase steps / delimiter when the sequence began with digit 3
explanation: Fires late in the original phase (t >= 6, mostly the last 1-3 input tokens) and on the <DEL> step, mainly in sequences whose first original token is the digit 3 (first_tok=3 has 18x lift and holds 80% of activation mass). Magnitude goes up with position: top activations are on the last original token or the one before it in long (L=8-9) sequences that start with 3, often reaching ~1.0 of max just before <DEL>, and <DEL> itself at ~0.5-0.7. It never fires in the copy phase (t > L) or at t <= 4. The current input token barely matters. Weak activations (~20% of mass) also show up late in sequences that do not start with 3, so recall is incomplete. Precision is reduced by short sequences (L=6) that start with 3, where it often stays silent. Dev: P 0.64, R 0.58, F1 0.61, mass recall 0.79.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: 3, l, b, p, 2, g; least: 1, w, n, 0) and the previous input (most: w, c, n, e, z, 0; least: h, p, 3, i); timing cues that raise it most: t=7, L=9 & t=8, t=8.
